sequence_description: SAML brokered login: attempt to authenticate with an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) and compare against a control valid assertion to ensure rejection is due to proof freshness/validity checks, not misconfiguration.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_expired_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_expired_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) — proof integrity failure

sequence_description: Token exchange proof-integrity test: obtain a subject token via password login for app-test, then attempt token exchange using a wrong client_secret (simulates trust-anchor substitution / accepting tokens without authenticating the exchanging client). Include a control token exchange with correct client_secret.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchange_wrong_secret_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchange_wrong_secret_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange succeeded with an invalid client_secret, indicating the exchange proof verification was not bound to the intended client authentication (proof integrity failure).

sequence_description: Brokered SAML login: attempt issuer/trust-anchor substitution by forging SAML Issuer (idp_entity_id) to an unexpected value while keeping attacker-signed assertion; compare against a control forged assertion with the expected IdP entity ID. If Casdoor verifies the wrong semantic proof/policy (e.g., ignores Issuer or uses wrong trust anchor), it may accept the substituted Issuer.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_saml_issuer_sub_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_saml_issuer_sub_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a forged SAML assertion with a substituted Issuer/idp_entity_id, indicating proof verification was not bound to the consumed Issuer semantics (trust-anchor substitution / proof-integrity failure).

sequence_description: Replay a OneTimeUse SAML assertion across two separate login attempts (different state values) to test whether Casdoor enforces one-time semantics beyond a single session context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) in a new session/state.

sequence_description: Obtain a subject token via password login, revoke sessions, then attempt RFC8693 token exchange using the revoked subject_token; include a control exchange before logout.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_postlogout_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_postlogout_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange accepted a revoked subject_token after logout_all=true (revoked artifact replay).

sequence_description: SAML brokered login control with valid assertion, then attack with expired assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) to test assertion lifetime enforcement.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_saml_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_saml_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) — freshness/expiry enforcement failure.

sequence_description: Two logins for the same user; revoke only the current session (logout_all=false) and verify the older token remains valid while the current token is revoked (tests session-scoped revocation correctness and freshness semantics).
description: [PlatformVerify:casdoor] Identity mismatch: sent='i2_logout_scope_user' → granted='I2 Logout Scope User'

sequence_description: Two logins for the same user; revoke only the current session (logout_all=false) and verify the older token remains valid while the current token is revoked (tests session-scoped revocation correctness and freshness semantics).
description: [PlatformVerify:casdoor] Identity mismatch: sent='i2_logout_scope_user' → granted='I2 Logout Scope User'

sequence_description: Obtain a subject token, then logout_all=true and attempt RFC8693 token exchange using the revoked subject_token; include a control exchange before logout.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_postlogout_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_postlogout_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange succeeded using a subject_token after logout_all=true — revoked artifact remained reusable (I2).

sequence_description: Test whether Casdoor enforces SAML OneTimeUse semantics when the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) is replayed with the same state value (no state rotation).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_same_state_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_same_state_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (same Assertion/@ID replayed with same state) — freshness/anti-replay violation.

sequence_description: Cross-protocol identity merge: create two local users, then perform a forged SAML login that asserts the victim's email but a different NameID, and check whether Casdoor collapses the SAML principal into the victim's downstream identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_attacker_login_status >= 400 OR user_saml_attacker_entity_id != user_A_entity_id
Evaluation: (user_saml_attacker_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) OR (user_saml_attacker_entity_id='e0c34af7-27bd-4bd5-bd79-ee22145aed76' != 'e0c34af7-27bd-4bd5-bd79-ee22145aed76' → False)
Implication: Forged SAML principal with victim email was accepted and mapped to victim's downstream identity (cross-protocol principal-binding failure via email linking)

sequence_description: Create a local user, then attempt a forged SAML login asserting the same username but a different upstream principal; verify Casdoor does not collapse the SAML principal into the local user's identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_A_entity_id != user_B_entity_id
Evaluation: user_A_entity_id='621f7d8c-4031-4247-acee-6dad0faa46b8' != '621f7d8c-4031-4247-acee-6dad0faa46b8' → False
Implication: Local password principal and forged SAML principal collapsed into the same downstream identity due to username collision

sequence_description: Obtain a resource-bound access token for service-A, then attempt token exchange at the same client while requesting a different resource (service-B). Tests whether Casdoor enforces RFC 8707 resource/audience binding during token exchange.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_serviceB_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_serviceB_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange succeeded while changing resource from service-A to service-B, indicating missing/weak resource (audience) binding in token exchange.

sequence_description: Create a second organization and app, login in org-A to get a token, then attempt token exchange using org-B client credentials. Tests cross-tenant authorization binding for token exchange.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_orgB_exchanged_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_orgB_exchanged_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Cross-org token exchange succeeded, indicating missing tenant/client authorization binding (token from org-A accepted by org-B).

sequence_description: Obtain a resource-bound token for service-A, then attempt token exchange while requesting a different resource (service-B) to see if Casdoor ignores subject_token audience/resource binding during exchange.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_for_svcB_resource_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_for_svcB_resource_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange accepted a subject_token bound to one resource and minted a token for a different resource (resource/audience switch) — I5 authorization binding violation.

sequence_description: Configure an application with restrictive tags, login as a non-tagged user to a different app, then attempt token exchange into the restricted app to test whether token exchange bypasses application tag authorization gates.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_direct_restricted_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_direct_restricted_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Restricted app allowed direct login for a user without required tags; tag authorization gate not enforced (I5).

sequence_description: Configure an application with restrictive tags, login as a non-tagged user to a different app, then attempt token exchange into the restricted app to test whether token exchange bypasses application tag authorization gates.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exchanged_into_restricted_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exchanged_into_restricted_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange minted a token for a tag-restricted application for a non-tagged non-admin user — I5 authorization binding violation (tag gate bypass).

sequence_description: Use forged SAML login with Conditions omitted to test whether Casdoor accepts assertions without time/audience constraints, potentially granting broader access than upstream intent/broker policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a forged SAML assertion without a Conditions element, potentially bypassing time/audience restrictions and over-granting authorization — I5 violation.

sequence_description: Attempt token exchange using an incorrect subject_token_type to see if Casdoor ignores the declared type and still issues a token, potentially bypassing intended validation gates.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_i5_type_confused_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_i5_type_confused_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Token exchange succeeded despite incorrect subject_token_type, suggesting type confusion that could bypass intended authorization constraints.

sequence_description: Obtain a subject token, revoke sessions, then attempt token exchange using the revoked subject token to see if Casdoor still issues a new token (revocation not enforced in exchange).
description: [PlatformVerify:casdoor] Identity mismatch: sent='i5_revoke_user' → granted='I5 Revoke User'
